exposure: Type of retained surgical foreign body (RFB)
cohort: The cohort consists of 22 medical negligence cases related to retained surgical foreign bodies (RFB) that reached the National Consumer Dispute Redressal Commission in India.
finding: Nonmetallic retained surgical foreign bodies (RFB), particularly surgical mops, were more common, with gynecologists being the most frequently implicated specialty and caesarean section the most common surgery leading to RFB, though the type of RFB or specialty did not affect compensation awarded.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as the most common surgery leading to retained surgical foreign bodies (RFB).
